title: Wish I had returned. Overpriced air purifier
text: Wish I had returned. Overpriced air purifier. IF you are looking for something that cools a room, this is not it. As an air purifier, it is okay.

product_metadata.title: Dyson Pure Hot+Cool™ HP01 Air Purifier, Heater & Fan - White/Silver
features: Captures and traps pollutants for cleaner air.
Multifunctional. Purifies, heats, and cools you.²
360 ̊ filtration system combines a filter to capture odors and gases with HEPA to capture 99.97% of particles 0.3 microns in size.
Air Multiplier technology generates the circulation power to draw distant pollutants into the machine, projecting purified air throughout the whole room.¹
The filter is quick and easy to change. With automatic filter-life notifications on the machine.
Program your machine to turn off after pre-set intervals.
Curved and magnetized remote stores neatly on the machine.
Sleep timer for a comfortable night's sleep. The LED display will turn off after 10 seconds of inactivity.
description: The Dyson Pure Hot+Cool™ purifying heater is a purifier, fan, and heater in one. It delivers fast, long-range, and even room heating and purification. Air Multiplier™ technology amplifies surrounding air, providing an uninterrupted stream of smooth, yet powerful, purified airflow. It oscillates to project and circulate purified air throughout the whole room.¹
¹In Maximum setting. Tested for air projection (DTM801), purification coverage in a 2860ft3 room (TM-003711).
²Fan, not an air conditioning unit.

details.Included Components: Remote Control, Dyson 360° Glass HEPA Filter, Dyson Pure Hot+Cool™ HP01 Purifying Heater
